messages:
Samir: quick check-in re: vendor resilience runway — after last week's PM we promised concrete owners/timelines for cloud/model-registry/auth items. can we surface one-line owners + target dates?
Ava: I'll take cloud provider retry/backoff policy updates. target: 2026-04-07 for rollout and canary.
Claire: I'll own model-registry fallback wiring (read-only mirror + local artifact cache). aiming EOD 2026-04-12 for config PR.
Mateo: auth provider — token failover and short-circuit cache strategy. goal: 2026-04-05 to land s/kv cache + ttl script.
Priya: I'll coordinate test plan + runbook updates (incl. alert thresholds + runbook snippets). target: 2026-04-09.
Samir: nice. please call out blockers in-thread if any. also flagged: recurring incident pattern shows auth spikes + registry throttles on warm-up windows — want a small experiments list to validate mitigations.
Ava: blocker: cloud provider change affects SDK retry semantics. need eng-infra review. @Mateo can you pair for 1hr on Thu?
Mateo: yep can pair Thu 11-12 PT.
Claire: registry mirror needs a compact manifest sync — wondering if we should use rsync-style delta vs full blob copy. leaning delta. cc eng-ml for perf tradeoffs.
Priya: tests: synthetic load for warm-up, token expiry fuzz, and model-fetch throttling. I'll add scenarios to the qa-job matrix.
Samir: assigning items in tracker: https://redwood-internal/issue/INF-4821 — please add subtask ids and update progress.
DevOpsBot: New runbook version created: /runbooks/vendor-resilience/v2 — changelog: added auth short-circuit steps and model registry mirror checklist.
Ava: quick config snippet I'm drafting:
```
# retry policy
retries: 4
backoff_ms: [100, 250, 600, 1500]
circuit_breaker: 5/min
```
I'll post PR in eng-infra by EOD.
Mateo: auth short-circuit idea: if primary auth fails 3x in 60s, route to cached-ttl tokens for 2m and escalate to oncall. I'll prototype script and share.
Claire: noted: dependent change for model-serving to respect local mirror priority — I'll open infra + runtime PRs.
Priya: scheduling a follow-up sync Wed 2026-04-08 9am PT to review canaries and test results. invite sent.
Samir: outstanding risk: provider-side throttling during batch model loads. mitigation: stagger preloads + aggressive KV caching. need numbers from eng-runtime on memory tradeoffs.
Ava: I'll run a small benchmark on staging and post numbers here by Tue.
Mateo: adding a monitoring alert: auth-fail-rate > 2% for 10m -> fire a 'vendor-dep-degradation' pager. PR in monitoring repo tomorrow.
Priya: will update runbook with the new pager escalation and add play templates.
Samir: thanks all. please update INF-4821 and drop any quick notes back here. :thumbsup:
Claire: quick note — eng-ml suggested we also validate quantization artifacts when mirror is used (to avoid transferral regressions). added to my subtask.
Ava: ack. will include in canary checklist.
DevOpsBot: Reminder: scheduled chaos drill (auth-provider failover) on 2026-04-10 16:00 PT. RSVP in calendar.
Mateo: RSVP'd.
Priya: thanks — I'll run through runbook during the drill and capture gaps.
Samir: perfect. closing this check-in — we'll reconvene after the Wed sync.
